caption: The drawing consists of four rectangular patterns arranged in a grid, two at the top and two at the bottom, all centered on a plain, off-white background. The upper left rectangle features a green grid pattern with closely spaced horizontal and vertical lines, creating a checkered appearance. The upper right rectangle is filled with a solid red background, overlaid by two intersecting pairs of thick brown stripes in a cross formation; at each crossing and at the intersections with the edges are white circular shapes detailed with gray hexagonal and black dot patterns. The lower left rectangle has a pale background with three purple geometric motifs resembling stylized floral or starburst shapes, placed diagonally from top left to bottom right, with smaller similar motifs dotting the open areas. The lower right rectangle is filled with a dense, intricate pattern in pale purple and darker blue, featuring overlapping star-like and floral shapes interspersed throughout. The artist’s name "ADA BARNES" is faintly typed below the patterns, and additional handwritten and printed text is visible at the bottom left of the page, including the words "calico prints" and a date "6/30/41."
title: Calico Prints
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
